name: surestep
scope: Instant Xbox Blink and damage-only arrow shortcuts; paginated Quest water settings; optional tracked-hand ray/pinch spatial UI with safe controller handover; original humanoid proportions, articulated knees/elbows and movement-driven planted feet. Existing combat, hitboxes, routes, saves and VR/AR modes are preserved.
saveCompatibility: No save keys, generator state, collision floors or scored progression are changed. Existing v0.9+ checkpoints and permanent profiles continue through their existing validated envelopes.
hardwareStatus: Software acceptance uses real WebGL with emulated Xbox buttons, WebXR controllers and hand joints. Physical Quest 3 tracking, comfort, thermal behavior, performance and real Xbox lifecycle checks remain open.
